findings.message: The new closed report has to be registered in `squatch/stages.py::KNOWN_ARTIFACTS` so the ordinary lane can validate and lift it. The merged precedents do this: daemon-soak's 'Stages registers it in KNOWN_ARTIFACTS', and `ReliabilityBatteryReport` is registered there too. `completed_output_lift` (squatch/stages.py:105) only counts lifted paths whose name is in `KNOWN_ARTIFACTS`. So when the no-code `go-grade-run` writes `tickets/go-grade-run/review-baseline-report.json` to its OUTBOX, that file is neither schema-validated nor counted as a completed lift. `phase6-exit` then has no closed committed report to read. The section 20 row fences only `eval/harness.py`, `squatch/artifacts.py`, `tests/test_eval_harness.py`, and `tests/test_go_grade.py`, and `tests/test_seeded_phase6_02.py` pins that exact fence. The author therefore cannot add `squatch/stages.py`.
